decision.reason: [ev-2537a3d7a014] is a one-line changelog entry with the conventional-commit scope "fix(ci)". It changes the project's own init-release step to use a pinned Helm version, which is internal release tooling and not a product field, flag, API or runtime behaviour an operator configures. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or works differently for a deployed Argo CD, so "none" (informational, low) is the consequence the evidence supports. This rests on reading the "ci" scope, not on an explicit statement, so confidence is low.
